text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса thrills the audience with
her
victory against Спешл Уик.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But this race wasn't enough for Special
Week.
She's eager for a rematch with El
Condor Pasa at
the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This now means that Эль Кондор Паса,
Special
Week, and Грасс Вандер will all
face off in the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the Arima Kinen has turned
into a
battle between three close friends
and a
much-anticipated race for the
audience.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
